plain: Making sure a law or a rule is obeyed

webster.text: Giving force or strength; compelling; urging; constraining; putting in execution.

example.quote: The only means, then, of enforcing obedience to the legislative authority must be through the medium of the officers of peace.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, North Carolina Convention, Mr. DAVIE, July 29, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
